dataset: NASA PDS Geosciences Node LOLA RDR GDS selected topography

records.name: LOLA south-pole candidate point 0E
records.topographyUnit: m relative to 1737.4 km lunar mean radius
records.slopeMethod: Least-squares planar fit to all valid LOLA topography points returned in this 0.01° latitude × 0.1° longitude query window. This slope is derived by this package and is not an official LOLA slope field.
records.productVersion: PDS3 label; generated 2026-11-13 (no archive release number stated in supplied label)
records.selectionMethod: Raw observation nearest the query-window center; representative point, not a NASA-designated landing site.
records.limitations: Topography is relative to the stated mean radius. The displayed slope is derived locally from sparse valid observations, not an official NASA slope field; game suitability scores are educational abstractions, not landing safety advice.
